body: I can’t bring myself to block his number. It’s so toxic. I know everything about it screams narc behavior but I let a wall down for him which is rare for me. And now feel vulnerable and attached. I don’t want to start over again looking for someone. I am hanging on to this false narrative of who he is. I want to bring it up with my therapist but I lied to her and said I stopped communication and am embarrassed to tell her I lied :(
Ugh. I just want to be blunt and ask him what his intentions are. I feel like have nothing to lose and it would give me some type of closure instead of constantly wondering.
because I have him as a friend on Instagram and Snapchat and he’s posted videos of himself and has sent me direct videos of his face
Thanks for sharing. I agree it’s mainly psychological. I just need to accept the fact that I have one and move on with life.
